answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities at the inlet: each entrant posts a 400 POA bond and faces three peer auditors per epoch. Auditors are drawn fresh, so no ring audits itself; they check work logs, and a failed audit burns the bond and ejects the identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 POA, far above one reward, while an honest agent tends its orchard once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards in this haven.
